summary: Large day counts make checked_add_days and checked_sub_days panic while constructing Duration::days instead of returning None, also affecting DateTime through delegation. The fix checks multiplication into seconds and the duration bounds before constructing Duration::seconds. The implementation reversal is exact and unique. Blocked test selection: the detecting assertions added by this fix are doctests for NaiveDate::checked_add_days and NaiveDate::checked_sub_days in src/naive/date.rs, using Days::new(1000000000000). The current prototype runner supports named unit/integration test functions, not doctests. Existing named day-arithmetic tests do not exercise this duration overflow. No builds or tests were executed.
